pokedexEntries.sw: It stores poison in an internal poison sac and secretes that poison through its skin. If you touch this Pokémon, a tingling sensation follows.

pokedexEntries.sh: It manipulates the chemical makeup of its poison to produce electricity. The voltage is weak, but it can cause a tingling paralysis.

pokedexEntries.sc: It has no problem drinking dirty water. An organ inside Toxel's body filters such water into a poisonous liquid that is harmless to Toxel.

pokedexEntries.vi: This selfish, attention-seeking Pokémon stores poison and electricity in two different sacs inside its body.

pokedexEntries.za: It manipulates the chemical makeup of its poison to produce electricity. The wattage is weak, but it can cause a tingling numbness.
